vad_only.rule: every user onset while the agent speaks stops the agent (decision at the VAD onset)

duration_0ms.rule: stop if the user's VAD run (gaps <= 0.3 s bridged) lasts > 0 ms

duration_240ms.rule: stop if the user's VAD run (gaps <= 0.3 s bridged) lasts > 240 ms

duration_400ms.rule: stop if the user's VAD run (gaps <= 0.3 s bridged) lasts > 400 ms

duration_500ms.rule: stop if the user's VAD run (gaps <= 0.3 s bridged) lasts > 500 ms

duration_560ms.rule: stop if the user's VAD run (gaps <= 0.3 s bridged) lasts > 560 ms

duration_800ms.rule: stop if the user's VAD run (gaps <= 0.3 s bridged) lasts > 800 ms

duration_1000ms.rule: stop if the user's VAD run (gaps <= 0.3 s bridged) lasts > 1000 ms

duration_1200ms.rule: stop if the user's VAD run (gaps <= 0.3 s bridged) lasts > 1200 ms

duration_1500ms.rule: stop if the user's VAD run (gaps <= 0.3 s bridged) lasts > 1500 ms

min_words_1_560ms.rule: stop once >= 1 words are transcribed within 560 ms of the onset (oto: our streaming RNNT on the user channel; AMI / ICSI: reference words at their end time, no ASR delay = an upper bound)
